title: Arvind Sivakumaran
description: Arvind graduated in Film Production from Victoria Motion Picture School, B.C., Canada in 2002. He also holds a degree in English Literature from St. Xavier's College, Mumbai. With a strong foundation in both technical filmmaking and literary arts, Arvind brings a unique perspective to his creative work.
